module_summary: 10GBASE-R PHY receive interface: optionally bit-reverses and pipelines SERDES blocks, descrambles them with a 58-bit LFSR into registered encoded output, while frame-sync, BER-monitor and watchdog children supervise lock and optional PRBS31 checking counts errors.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_data
anchors.why: Raw 64-bit scrambled block payload from SERDES.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_hdr
anchors.why: 2-bit sync header from SERDES, used for lock and BER monitoring.

anchors.name: encoded_rx_data
anchors.why: Descrambled 64-bit block output to PCS decoder.

anchors.name: encoded_rx_hdr
anchors.why: Registered sync header output alongside encoded data.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_data_int
anchors.why: Bit-reversed, optionally pipelined SERDES data feeding descrambler and PRBS checker.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_hdr_int
anchors.why: Conditioned header fanned out to frame sync, BER monitor and watchdog.

anchors.name: descrambled_rx_data
anchors.why: Self-synchronous descrambler output registered into encoded data.

anchors.name: scrambler_state_reg
anchors.why: 58-bit descrambler LFSR state updated every block.

anchors.name: encoded_rx_data_reg
anchors.why: Output register selecting descrambled or raw data per SCRAMBLER_DISABLE.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_bitslip
anchors.why: Bitslip request from frame sync to SERDES, masked during PRBS31 test.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_reset_req
anchors.why: Watchdog SERDES reset request, masked during PRBS31 test.

anchors.name: rx_block_lock
anchors.why: Block lock from frame sync; also feeds watchdog.

anchors.name: rx_high_ber
anchors.why: High bit-error-rate flag from BER monitor; also feeds watchdog.

anchors.name: rx_status
anchors.why: Overall receive link status from watchdog.

anchors.name: cfg_rx_prbs31_enable
anchors.why: Enables PRBS31 checking and masks bitslip/reset requests.

anchors.name: prbs31_data_reg
anchors.why: PRBS31 checker error bits per block, popcounted for errors.

anchors.name: rx_error_count_reg
anchors.why: Per-block PRBS31 bit-error count summed from two partial counts.

groups.name: serdes_input_conditioning
groups.description: Optional bit reversal and pipeline registers on SERDES data and header.

groups.name: descrambler
groups.description: 58-bit self-synchronous LFSR descrambler of block payload.

groups.name: encoded_output
groups.description: Registers descrambled data and header onto the encoded interface.

groups.name: frame_sync
groups.description: Child block-sync controller driving bitslip and block lock.

groups.name: ber_monitor
groups.description: Child monitor flagging high BER from invalid headers.

groups.name: rx_watchdog
groups.description: Child watchdog generating SERDES reset request and rx_status.

groups.name: prbs31_checker
groups.description: Parameter-gated PRBS31 pattern checker counting bit errors per block.
